One beam per satellite points at the receiver (maximum over groups, not their sum)
Receiver values are ITU-R reference values (receiver_classes.json, pending review)
N = max(10⁴, ⌈100/p⌉) samples per hazard, at least ⌈100/p⌉ per site, at most 10⁶

Co-channel: the carrier is placed inside the receiver channel (worst placement)
